_about: The 9 landing photos (src/lib/queries/landing.ts CURATED_SLUGS), in slot order. Each was opened at 1920 px and judged by eye: sharp, uncluttered, no brand or label text, appetising, and the dish it is labelled as. Source files are the 1920 px Commons rendition (scripts/photos/hires.py).

slots.0: hero tile (square crop, title scrim): japanese-curry-rice, clean white ground, 1920x1440 source of a 3797x2848 original
slots.6: big tile of 'Why we built this' (tall crop): sopa-de-tortilla, square 1920x1920 source so a portrait crop loses nothing
